Name: Gummy Worm Dig Spots (CP)
Author: knifewizard
Description:
Replaces the sprites for the standard artifact dig spots with wiggly gummy worms. (Will not change the number of dig spot spawns on its own - in the screenshots, this was achieved using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3340?tab=files&file_id=20326]Increased Artifact Spots[/url].)

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Requires Content Patcher.[/url]

Downloads.Description: Replaces the standard artifact dig spots with gummy worms.

Manifest.Name: (CP) Gummy Worm Digspots
Manifest.Description: A patch replacing the wiggly dig spot roots with gummy worms.
